chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from Muhammad ibn Isa ibn Ubayd, from Yunus, from Muhammad ibn Mudarrib, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
Whoever accuses his wife before he has intercourse with her, he is whipped with the Hadd penalty, and she remains his wife.

key_terms.يَدْخُلَ بِهَا: He enters/copulates with her (consummation of marriage)

ai.seo_question: What is the punishment for a husband who accuses his wife of adultery before consummating the marriage?
ai.summary: This hadith clarifies that the fixed punishment (Hadd) for slander applies even before marital consummation, distinguishing it from cases where the wife might be divorced or retain dower. It underscores the legal continuity of the marital bond, ensuring the accused wife remains his wife while the husband faces the standard forty lashes for qadhf. This ruling highlights the protective nature of Shia jurisprudence regarding a woman's honor and status within the marriage contract.

en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from Muhammad Bin Isa Bin Ubeyd, from Yunus, from Muhammad Bin Muzarab,
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘The one who accuses his wife before he copulates with her would be whipped one Penalty (Hadd), and she would (still) be his wife’.
